venus.conjunction: You express affection in words and choose them well; charm, taste and conversation are a single faculty in you.
venus.harmonious: You are diplomatic without being insincere, you write and speak pleasantly, and most things can be defused by your saying them nicely.
venus.square: You smooth the phrasing until the meaning has gone out of it, and you avoid the one sentence that would settle the matter.
venus.opposition: You talk your way around what you feel, and it takes somebody else asking the blunt question to get it out of you.

mars.conjunction: You think fast and say it faster, and you are sharp, quick, and rather good at arguments you had no need to start.
mars.harmonious: You make decisions at speed and act on them, and you can be blunt without anybody taking offence at it.
mars.square: You speak before you have finished thinking, and the cleverness comes out as cutting far more often than you intend.
mars.opposition: You do your thinking against somebody; debate sharpens you, but you cannot always tell it apart from picking a fight.

jupiter.conjunction: You think in wide arcs, generalise happily, and are a genuinely good explainer who occasionally overstates the case.
jupiter.harmonious: You learn quickly and teach naturally, and you can hold a large subject in your head without losing your way inside it.
jupiter.square: You promise more in conversation than you can deliver, and the detail you skipped over is invariably the one that mattered.
jupiter.opposition: Your grand conclusions keep meeting somebody else's small facts, and most of what you know you learned by being corrected.

saturn.conjunction: You think carefully and slowly, say rather less than you know, and will not commit to a sentence you cannot defend.
saturn.harmonious: Your mind is orderly and retentive, you are good at anything requiring sustained concentration, and you finish what you start reading.
saturn.square: You censor yourself before speaking and then regret the silence, and you mistake your own caution for a lack of ability.
saturn.opposition: Criticism comes from outside and lands hard, and you have organised your thinking around never being caught out.

uranus.conjunction: Your mind jumps rather than walks; you arrive at the answer without the working and cannot always reconstruct how.
uranus.harmonious: You see the unusual angle quickly and can explain it, which makes you valuable whenever the standard approach has failed.
uranus.square: You are impatient with anything explained slowly, you interrupt, and you change your mind at the speed of the last good idea.
uranus.opposition: Other people supply the disruption to your thinking, and the conversations that changed you were the ones that irritated you at the time.

neptune.conjunction: You think in images rather than propositions, which makes you imaginative and thoroughly unreliable about details and appointments.
neptune.harmonious: You have an ear for what is not being said, and you can put a vague feeling into words other people recognise.
neptune.square: You are vague where precision was wanted and you know it, and you have talked yourself into believing your own softer version.
neptune.opposition: You are easily talked into things, and the misunderstandings in your life have come from what you assumed rather than checked.

pluto.conjunction: You do not skim: you research, and you would rather know the uncomfortable thing than stay comfortable not knowing it.
pluto.harmonious: You get to the bottom of matters people would rather leave alone, and you can say the difficult sentence without cruelty.
pluto.square: Your mind grinds, going over the same material for a hidden meaning, and you are suspicious when there turns out not to be one.
pluto.opposition: You meet your own obsessions in other people, and the arguments that mattered in your life were all about who was telling the truth.

ascendant.conjunction: You come across as your mind — talkative, quick, and closely identified with whatever you have just said.
ascendant.harmonious: You explain yourself easily and people understand you at the first pass, which quietly makes a great deal of your life simpler.
ascendant.square: The way you talk gets in the way of how you want to be taken, and you are read as glib or as awkward.
ascendant.opposition: You need somebody to think against, and you barely know your own view until you have said it to a face.

midheaven.conjunction: You are known for what you say or write, and communication is either your work or the reason you were given it.
midheaven.harmonious: You can put your work into words, and that advances you at least as much as the work itself does.
midheaven.square: Your ideas and your career pull apart, and you have spent years saying things that were not what you meant to say.
midheaven.opposition: Your public position and your private opinion diverge, and you have been careful about which of them you air.
